The 5T OTA is gm/C-limited. Only half the tail current reaches the output gm, and the mirror and vx poles cost more. With β≈0.993 the loop is almost a follower, so BW ≈ gm_total/(2πC_out). I'll switch to a self-biased CMOS inverter with resistive feedback. All the current then goes into gm_n+gm_p, there is one high-impedance node, and the DC level is set by the trip point, which is sized to exactly 0.9 V.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "5T OTA wastes half its current and adds mirror/vx poles; BW 158 MHz vs 300 MHz. A self-biased CMOS inverter with Rf/R1 feedback puts all current into gm_n+gm_p at one output node. Its trip point is sized to 0.9 V, and current is budgeted below 140 uW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "L_n":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "L_p":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "I_inv": (56e-6, 25e-6, 64e-6),
    "Rf":    (40e3, 8e3, 150e3),
    "trip":  (0.9, 0.86, 0.94),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    g = 0.007
    pmax = 140e-6
    I = min(p["I_inv"], 0.95 * pmax / vdd - iref)
    vt = p["trip"]

    # inverter devices sized so that at vgs=vds=trip (n) and vsg=vsd=vdd-trip (p) each carries I
    on = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L_n"], vt, vt)
    op_ = lut.op("p", 1.0, p["L_p"], vdd - vt, vdd - vt)
    mn = lut.size("n", on["gm_id"], p["L_n"], I, vds=vt)
    mp = lut.size("p", op_["gm_id"], p["L_p"], I, vds=vdd - vt)

    # reference current sink (diode) for ibias
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 0.5, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 0.5, iref, vds=mb.vgs)

    gm = mn.gm + mp.gm
    go = mn.gds + mp.gds
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    Ap = (gm - 1.0 / Rf) / (go + 1.0 / Rf)
    Ap = max(Ap, 1e-3)
    R1 = Rf * (Ap - g) / (g * (1.0 + Ap))
    R1 = max(R1, 1e3)
    a1 = -Ap * Rf / (R1 + Rf + Ap * R1)
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MN", "vout", "vx", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "vx", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vx", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vx", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    # predicted trip point by bisection on the forward model
    def mism(v):
        In = lut.op("n", mn.W, p["L_n"], v, v)["Id"]
        Ip = lut.op("p", mp.W, p["L_p"], vdd - v, vdd - v)["Id"]
        return In - Ip
    lo, hi = 0.5, 1.3
    for _ in range(30):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if mism(mid) > 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    vtrip = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    cout = cl + mn.cdd + mp.cdd
    cx = mn.cgg + mp.cgg + 2e-15
    rx = Rf * R1 / (Rf + R1)
    bw0 = (gm * beta + go + 1.0 / Rf) / (2 * PI * cout)
    p_vx = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rx * cx)
    bw = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 / bw0**2 + 0.5 / p_vx**2)
    power = vdd * (iref + I)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": vtrip - 0.9,
               "power": power, "loop_gain_db": db(max(Ap * beta, 1e-9))}
```
